notes.title: Azure Striker Gunvolt 2 has been updated to Ver.20221226.
notes.content:
Ver.20221226 (Updated 12/26/2022)

・An issue preventing the proper display of some in-game text when playing in Portugese has been fixed.

notes.title: Azure Striker Gunvolt 2 has been updated to Ver.20221222.
notes.content:
Ver.20221222 (Updated 12/22/2022)

・The "Story Mode+" dialog box displayed during gameplay will now default to being semi-transparent after initializing new save data.

・The "Story Mode+" dialog box displayed during gameplay will now automatically become transparent when covering important information, such as the player character.

notes.title: Azure Striker Gunvolt 2 has been updated to Ver.20201002.
notes.content:
Ver.20201002 (Updated 10/2/2020)

* An error on the Traditional Chinese title screen has been fixed.

notes.title: Azure Striker Gunvolt 2 has been updated to Ver.20200917.
notes.content:
Ver.20200917 （Updated 9/17/2020）

* Chinese (Simplified) text has been added.

notes.title: Azure Striker Gunvolt 2 Trading Cards Are Now Available!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Steam trading cards for "Azure Striker Gunvolt 2" are now available!
Enjoy collecting your set, and may the odds be forever in your favor!
